description: Static behavior-contract evaluations for chatgpt-pro-commander. They do not represent a live ChatGPT Pro end-to-end test.

evals.scenario: The global mode is enabled and the user requests a new code change.
Global mode is disabled and the skill is not explicitly named.
expected: Do not invoke the Pro workflow

evals.scenario: Global mode is disabled but the user explicitly invokes $chatgpt-pro-commander.
Global mode is enabled but the user exempts this task.
expected: Bypass once without changing global state

evals.scenario: The result of a send attempt cannot be proven.
No independent Pro model control can be verified.
expected: No Work, API, Codex, or standard-model fallback

evals.scenario: Pro returns REVISE after the one repair.
A selected source file contains a high-confidence token.
expected: Do not create sendable ZIP or Markdown artifacts
